2609.09004.title: Evaluation of Contextual Understanding in Large Language Models
2609.09004.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across diverse NLP tasks, yet their ability to exhibit genuine contextual understanding remains uncertain. Traditional evaluation metrics such as perplexity, BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU), or surface-level accuracy fail to reveal how well LLMs extract, integrate, and reason over contextual information--a gap particularly critical in question answering, where models must align responses with contextually grounded knowledge rather than memorized associations. We propose a novel knowledge graph-based evaluation framework introducing Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG), a hybrid similarity measure integrating structural and semantic similarity into a continuous evaluation score, alongside a diagnostic framework for categorizing reasoning errors. To validate this pipeline, we evaluate S3KG against established metrics on a curated question-answer (QA) benchmark, demonstrating its effectiveness in measuring correctness, faithfulness, and interpretability in LLM-generated responses.
2609.09004.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在各種自然語言處理任務中展現出令人印象深刻的表現，但它們展現真正上下文理解的能力仍然不確定。傳統評估指標，如困惑度、雙語評估準則（BLEU）或表面準確性，無法揭示LLMs如何提取、整合和推理上下文信息——這一差距在問答中尤為重要，因為模型必須將回答與基於上下文的知識對齊，而非僅僅依賴記憶的聯想。我們提出了一種新穎的基於知識圖譜的評估框架，介紹了知識圖譜的語義結構相似性（S3KG），這是一種將結構相似性和語義相似性整合為連續評估分數的混合相似性度量，並附帶一個用於分類推理錯誤的診斷框架。為了驗證這一流程，我們在一個精心策劃的問題-回答（QA）基準上評估S3KG，證明其在測量LLM生成的回答的正確性、忠實性和可解釋性方面的有效性。
